nudge.explain: Source edits with no test, build or type-check between them accumulate unverified assumptions; the later a failure surfaces, the more of the turn has to be redone. A test run right after the edit is cheap (its output is short) and lets the model fix the failure while the file is still in context. Reads of an edited file count as a check too — only when Claude re-reads the whole result. Documentation edits and sessions that have never run a test are exempt.
